%%%STDOUT%%%
usage: paceghost [-h] {show,ghost,race,season,board,fieldday,ladder,rematch} ...

Race a recorded run against the ghost of your best run.

positional arguments:
  {show,ghost,race,season,board,fieldday,ladder,rematch}
    show                print one recorded run
    ghost               print the standing ghost
    race                race a live run against a ghost
    season              print the season report for a field of runs
    board               print the live board for a run carrying timed reads
    fieldday            print the stolen record report for a field day
    ladder              print the ladder report for a field day and its windows
    rematch             print the rematch report for two field days

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
%%%STDERR%%%
